modules.name: Original goal board
modules.note: Needs the goal board and tiles from base Wingspan.

steps.text: Shuffle the bird deck beside the bird tray; fill the tray with {n} faceup birds
All food tokens and eggs in the supply
Roll the food dice onto the birdfeeder board
Shuffle the bonus cards into a deck
Duet map with {n} random Duet goal tiles (red corners) in the slots below it
Base game goal board with {n} random goal tiles, random side up
Each player: a player mat (inside section) and {n} action cubes of one color
A Duet token of your color on each of the 15 bird slots on your mat
Deal each player {n} birds, 2 bonus cards and 5 food (one of each)
Keep 5 of your 10 cards and food in any mix; keep 1 bonus card
Round tracker card showing Round 1 in the Automa's area
Duet map tracker card to its right, also Round 1
Shuffle the 10 Automa cards (plus at most 1 special card) facedown as the Automa deck
Include the Automasian Alliance card
Give the Automa action cubes of an unused color and a random Automa-only bonus card
End-of-round goal scoring card, Round 1 up, beside the goal board
Choose the difficulty level
Each time you play a bird, place a Duet token on the Duet map
You take the first turn of each round; the Automa takes the last
Random first player takes the first-player token
Each turn: play a bird, gain food, lay eggs, or draw birds
